p: Gath and her towns out of: Which 2Sa 8:1 calls the bridle of bondage, because it was a strong town and kept the country around it in subjection.
preserved David whithersoever he went: That is in all things that he attempted.
Tibhath: Which in 2Sa 8:8 is called Betah and Berothai.
Hadoram his son to king David: Called also Joram 2Sa 8:10.
Edom: Because the Edomites and the Syrians joined their power together, it is said, 2Sa 8:12 that the Amramites were spoiled.
eighteen thousand: Which is understood that Joab slew 12,000 as is in Ps 60:1 and Abishai the rest.
